note: Vector-path constants for BW1100 + this DTK. Everything here is either an operator property or a library property; the hardware lives in the hardware profile. ops_per_element is the vector work the operation is defined to do (softmax: max, subtract, exp, accumulate, scale; gelu erf: the erf polynomial plus the gating multiply; tanh-gelu: one polynomial), NOT a fitted number. row_cycles is the per-row block setup and cross-lane reduction, kept in cycles because it is latency rather than arithmetic. efficiency is the calibrated quantity: the fraction of the vector unit the vendor kernel actually reaches, fitted per operator, dtype and regime. Change the hardware profile and the prediction follows the hardware; only efficiency would need re-measuring. row_capacity_elements is where the library stops using softmax_warp_forward (row kept in registers, template parameter log2(R) = 9, 10, 11 for 512, 1024, 2048) and switches to cunn_SoftMaxForwardGmem (row streamed from global memory and read twice, which is what the L1D spill term in vector_ops accounts for). layernorm carries the softmax efficiency on purpose: it is a prediction, not a fit. fp32 has no reduction measurement, so its reduction constants mirror fp16.
